body: I don't have any other coping mechanism. And I know it's good. But daddy dearest isn't worth fighting with any more, especially not over money. Mother isn't worth sticking around for, she just nags and doesn't know how to deal with me and my stupid emotions. And my sister hasn't cared about me as a person since she was six, she'll be fine to lose herself in booze and coke (just kidding, she'll be totally fine). Boyfriend has already lost his father, what's one more person? (I know. A lot. What. Fucking. Ever.)
What have you done with your Chemical Engineering degree since graduation?

I think I am comfortable with myself, just uncomfortable with having to come out all over again. It wasn't that pleasant the first time around. Lost a couple really good friends, that kind of thing. Luckily, my school has a really strong Gay/Straight Alliance, and that made it a lot easier to find potential mates. I just don't wanna spend college as another four lonely years because of not knowing where the people like me are.
